mapper.sql: id, login_identity_id, create_idempotency_key, key_digest, key_hint, status, expires_at, last_used_at, row_version, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_api_key ( id, login_identity_id, create_idempotency_key, key_digest, key_hint, status, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{id,jdbcType=BINARY}, #{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{createIdempotencyKey, javaType=java.util.UUID, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.PostgreSqlUuidTypeHandler}, #{keyDigest,jdbcType=BINARY}, #{keyHint,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} ) ON CONFLICT (create_idempotency_key) WHERE create_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_api_key WHERE create_idempotency_key = #{createIdempotencyKey, javaType=java.util.UUID, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.PostgreSqlUuidTypeHandler}

SELECT key_record.id AS api_key_id, key_record.login_identity_id, key_record.key_digest, key_record.status AS key_status, key_record.expires_at, profile.account_status, model.id AS ai_model_id, model.model_name, model.vendor, model.is_enabled AS model_enabled, grant_record.status AS mapping_status, model.input_ratio, model.cached_input_ratio, model.output_ratio, model.context_window_tokens, model.max_output_tokens FROM user_api_key key_record JOIN user_profile profile ON profile.login_identity_id = key_record.login_identity_id LEFT JOIN user_api_key_model grant_record ON grant_record.user_api_key_id = key_record.id AND grant_record.ai_model_id = #{aiModelId,jdbcType=BIGINT} JOIN ai_model model ON model.id = #{aiModelId,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE key_record.id = #{apiKeyId,jdbcType=BINARY} FOR UPDATE OF key_record, profile, model
